limitations: The desktop has local-only email/password acquisition and in-memory refresh foundations behind injected components. T0040 enables a provisioned local identity and runtime validation, but no routed composition, persisted session, remote target or production call is implemented.
Creation, deletion and a bounded owner-presence read are covered; later company profile mutations are not designed.
Only synthetic local and CI data are admitted.

Bounded catalogue, purchase and owner-fleet reads are composed behind explicit user actions. Lease creation, catch-up and termination are server commands only; no scheduler, endpoint, desktop lease composition, live connectivity or deployment is provided.

evidenceMarkers: owner A cannot dispatch owner B aircraft
an unknown departure aerodrome is rejected without naming the reference
a suspended aircraft receives no new dispatch draft
an unusable aircraft is indistinguishable from a foreign aircraft at dispatch
limitations: An authenticated bounded endpoint, the server-created idempotent draft, one bounded desktop caller behind an explicit submission and one constant owner-scoped Data API read refreshed after a creation are covered; the desktop declares no client mutation and no ownership filter, RLS flight_dispatches_select_own stays the only selection authority, and no live WebView proof, remote deployment, SimBrief preparation, lifecycle transition, flight runtime or financial impact is implemented.

The bounded aerodrome reference is server-owned, read-only for authenticated and mutable by no client role. It has no client consumer yet, so it is deliberately absent from clientDataApiReads; the reference stays partial and carries no monetary value.

Draft creation now opposes the end of an aircraft lease: it reads company_aircraft.is_usable on the server-derived row, under lock, and refuses with the message already delivered so that an aircraft out of contract stays indistinguishable from a foreign one. The lease commands remain the only author of that state, and no due-date scheduler exists, so the guard is exact against the recorded state, not against wall-clock time.

evidenceMarkers: owner A cannot start owner B dispatch
a draft created while usable cannot depart once usage is suspended
a start acquired before the usage loss replays the stored response identically
limitations: Only the server transitions from one owned draft to one server-timed active flight, and from that flight to one of the two terminal states, are covered. No Auth boundary, desktop caller, flight phase detection or resume exists. T0054 broadcasts bounded replay telemetry on the local bridge contract to authenticated loopback subscribers only, without persisting flight state or linking any sample to a company, a flight or the ledger.

The flight start now opposes the end of an aircraft lease: it derives the aircraft from the dispatch, locks it last in the documented company, dispatch, aircraft order and refuses a fresh draft-to-active transition on an unusable aircraft with its existing opaque message. A start already acquired replays unchanged, and close_flight is deliberately unguarded so a flight under way stays closeable, per Andy's decision of 4 August 2026.

evidenceMarkers: a second closure of the same flight is rejected
limitations: Only the server closure of one owned active flight is covered: one terminal state, one bounded versioned report, one net credit and one reputation event in a single transaction. The report contract accepts a closed outcome, a bounded declared block time and optional bounded measurements only; the amount, the currency, the distance, the retained block time and the multiplier are recomputed or derived by the server. No Auth boundary, desktop caller, cancellation, SimBrief or telemetry-driven closure exists.

Opening, bounded authenticated catalogue read, one-off aircraft purchase, the single net flight settlement and the versioned lease rents are covered as separate components; routed composition, live connectivity and other financial commands are not defined. The settlement scale is an alpha decision protected by a floor and a per-flight cap, not a measured economic balance. Lease catch-up is manual service-role execution only; no scheduler and no routed lease endpoint exist.

evidenceMarkers: a score above the policy maximum is clamped to 100
a reputation event can never be rewritten
limitations: Only the informative reputation of a closed flight is covered: append-only deltas written inside the closure transaction and one owner-scoped bounded read. No client role can write an event, no capability is allowed, denied or modulated by the score, and no other progression mutation is implemented.
Maintenance state and costs are not implemented.
Schedules, rotations and temporal jobs are not implemented.
Managed encrypted backup, Vault/Storage restore, production promotion and signed updater rollback are absent.
Signed update, rollback and uninstall data-preservation proof are not implemented.
